name: dsh-web-bg
description: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI wallpaper and surface controls: paints bundled artwork behind the interface, adds a continuous interface-transparency axis over the app's surface tokens, and registers per-palette hex colours plus a transparency slider for the surfaces that stay solid.

dshWebBg.extensionsNote: The plugin halves and the installer deliberately avoid Windows' high-risk extension list (.js, .ps1) so a downloaded archive does not raise the Attachment Manager warning: the halves are .mjs and the installer ships as .ps1.txt.
